title: 匯出學員報名資料 + 付款報表 — Admin CSV + Excel
content:
在 Admin 後台匯出報名與付款報表為 CSV / XLSX。這是由 Registrant、User、Course 組成的報表投影，不是資料表原樣匯出。

資料來源：
- Registrant：報名 ID、類型、團體 ID、付款方式、金額、狀態、收據、提交日期及付款人欄位。
- User：姓名、Email、IA 牌照及身份證件欄位；User 是身份資料的唯一來源，Registrant 同名欄位不作為權威值。
- Course：課程名稱與 IA 參考編號。

GET /api/admin/enrolments/export 支援 format、status、courseId、startDate、endDate、search；GET /api/admin/payments/export 支援 format、status、paymentMethod、startDate、endDate。兩個 endpoint 均限 ADMIN 並提供 CSV / XLSX 下載。單一 Registrant ID 是付款匯出的識別碼；目前 schema 沒有獨立 Payment model、Alipay trade number、付款時間或退款時間，不得將這些欄位列為現有匯出承諾。超過 10,000 筆回傳錯誤要求縮小範圍，不提供背景 email 匯出。依賴 AF-019 工具庫。

findings: GET /api/admin/enrolments/export?format=csv|xlsx — supports status, courseId, startDate, endDate, search filters
GET /api/admin/payments/export?format=csv|xlsx — supports status, paymentMethod, startDate, endDate filters
Enrolments page has Export CSV + Export Excel buttons in header
Payments page created with Export CSV + Export Excel buttons
Admin sidebar nav updated with Payments link (DollarSign icon)
Large dataset (>10000 rows) returns 413 with error message
Dictionary keys added to en, zh-hk, zh-cn
typecheck passes (0 errors), lint passes (0 new warnings)
evidence.residual: Payments page is minimal (info + export only). Full payment listing table is deferred — export is the primary action. Background email delivery for >10K rows is not implemented (MVP returns error message instead).

acceptance: All filter params (status, courseId, date range) applied correctly in export
Identity-document fields in both exports are sourced from User, not Registrant duplicate fields
Payment report documents Registrant.id as its identifier and excludes payment/refund timestamps or provider IDs absent from schema
Admin Enrolments page has Export CSV + Export Excel buttons
Admin Payments page has Export CSV + Export Excel buttons
Download triggers immediate file download with correct filename
Large dataset (>10000 rows) shows appropriate handling message
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/[locale]/admin/payments/page.tsx (new — payments page with export buttons)
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && visit /en/admin/enrolments → click Export CSV → file downloads and opens correctly in Excel.
